create_MetalLinear: create a MetalLinear quantized linear layer with uint32 packed weights and Metal kernel forward pass
replace_with_metal_linear: replace nn.Linear modules in a model with MetalLinear quantized layers
quantize_tensor_affine: quantize a float weight tensor into packed uint32 weights with scales and qbiases
dequantize_tensor_affine: dequantize a packed uint32 weight tensor back to full-precision float
load_metal_kernel: load the quantization-mlx Metal kernel from Hugging Face Hub for affine matrix multiplication
